description: Belib' - Points de recharge pour véhicules électriques - Disponibilité temps réel is a dataset listed in Paris Data open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Direction de la Voirie et des Déplacements - Ville de Paris. Donnée géolocalisée de disponibilité en temps réel des Points de recharge [ Bélib' ] pour véhicules électriques - Infrastructure de Recharge des Véhicules Electriques (IRVE) Le conseil de Paris a voté l’attribution d’une concession de services à un nouvel opérateur, Total Marketing France (TMF), pour l’exploitation technique et commerciale des bornes de recharge publiques à ... Coverage: Paris. The portal files it under Mobilité et Espace Public. Its keywords are BRVE, IRVE, Belib, Stationnement, véhicule électrique, rechargement. The portal shows 1,970 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-paris-fr-portal.
